answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 11780 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asslam'u Alakum Wa'rehmatullah, May I know, what's the definition of 'Islamic dress'?? Waiting for your reply soon, Jazak Allah. Question: Asslam'u Alakum Wa'rehmatullah, May I know, what's the definition of 'Islamic dress'?? Waiting for your reply soon, Jazak Allah. Answer ID: 11780 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 397/383=B/1430) Islamic dress is one which was worn by the Prophet (peace be upon him) or he ordered to wear it, or which was worn by the sahaba and pious Muslims. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
